title: Antibody design across observed and forecasted antigenic evolution
summary: Germinal Multi jointly optimizes one antibody paratope against several antigen variants. Designs bound resistance-associated EGFR variants and neutralized historical SARS-CoV-2 variants, including variants withheld from design; redesign of BD55-1205 restored neutralization of a forecast escape variant. Successful candidates came from screening tens of designs per campaign.
ai_technology: Germinal Multi (computational antibody design framework); evolutionary forecasting model

evidence.tested: Tens of designs per campaign were screened experimentally; designs bound EGFR variants and neutralized SARS-CoV-2 variants, including variants withheld from the design process.
evidence.unknown: Not stated in the reviewed material beyond the abstract; the prospective escape variant result is described as a single redesign case in the abstract.
evidence.ai_role: A computational framework designed antibodies de novo against multiple antigenic variants at once, and an evolutionary forecasting model guided redesign against a prospective escape variant.
